      generic "Ooey Gooey Cheese BlendOur handy dandy Shredded Cheese Blends make it easy-peasy to cook with cheese" [ref=e203] clickable [onclick]
        link "Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend" [ref=e174]
          heading "Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend" level="3" [ref=e173] clickable [cursor:pointer, tabindex]
            StaticText "Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend"
        paragraph ""
          StaticText "Our handy dandy Shredded Cheese Blends make it easy-peasy to cook with cheese. It’s also noteworthy that our Shredded Cheese Blend development process is not done willy-nilly. No, we carefully consider every itsy bitsy detail, including which cheeses pair well together, both in function and flavor. To prove the point, consider our latest offering, Trader Joe’s Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend. It’s a killer-diller combination of nutty gruyere, mild yellow Cheddar, sharp white Cheddar, and buttery Havarti. Far from namby-pamby, this creamy dreamy combo is the Ooiest and Gooiest we could find, based on our research."
          StaticText ""
          StaticText "Whether you’re using it to make a seasonal mac & cheese with our Organic Fall Leaf Pasta, grill a grilled cheese sandwich with Pumpkin Sourdough Bread, or indulge in a twice-baked Delicata Squash, our shredded Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend brings razzle-dazzle to any cheese-forward dish."
